connector.name: Food Logger MCP
connector.registryDescription: Food logging, nutrition summaries, and meal photo calorie and macro estimates.
connector.summary: Hosted at foodlog.sig.ai over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace ai.sig.foodlog, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token from https://foodlog.sig.ai/account. New users receive 5 trial photo-analysis credits.
